query: Compare Samsung Galaxy S25, iPhone 16 and Google Pixel 9 for battery, camera and price in India.
text:
## Quick comparison

| Phone | Battery | Camera | Price in India |
|---|---|---|---|
| Samsung Galaxy S25 | 4,000 mAh [21][31] | 50 MP main + 12 MP ultra-wide + 10 MP telephoto, 12 MP front [15][8] | Starts around ₹58,999 to ₹84,999 depending on listing and variant[23] |
| iPhone 16 | 3,561 mAh [27][35] | 48 MP main + 12 MP ultra-wide, 12 MP front [13][32] | Starts at ₹79,900 officially; some listings show ₹76,999 |
| Google Pixel 9 | 4,700 mAh [1][10] | 50 MP main + 48 MP ultra-wide, 10.5 MP front [17] | Starts around ₹79,999; some India listings show lower sale prices[12] |

## Battery

The Pixel 9 has the biggest battery here at 4,700 mAh, followed by the Galaxy S25 at 4,000 mAh, while the iPhone 16 has the smallest battery at 3,561 mAh.

## Camera

For rear cameras, the Galaxy S25 is the most versatile because it adds a telephoto lens, which helps with optical zoom.

The Pixel 9 and iPhone 16 both have strong dual-camera setups, but the Pixel 9 has the larger ultra-wide sensor on paper, while the iPhone 16 uses a 48 MP main camera paired with a 12 MP ultra-wide camera.

## Price

In India, the iPhone 16 officially starts at ₹79,900, the Pixel 9 starts at ₹79,999, and the Galaxy S25 often lists below both in current retail pricing, with some listings around ₹58,999 to ₹84,999 depending on storage and seller.

## Best pick by priority

- Best battery: Google Pixel 9.
- Best zoom and camera flexibility: Samsung Galaxy S25.
- Best iPhone option: iPhone 16, if you want iOS and Apple’s ecosystem.

If you want, I can also turn this into a simple recommendation based on your budget and whether you care more about photos, gaming, or battery life.
